Coverage

Primary instance only: settlement, proofs, state execution, direct users, exclusive helpers, administration and approvals. Included receipts cover 16,547 of 106,212 deposit parent transactions and 33,958 of 34,739 withdrawal-claim parents. Unresolved external wrappers remain excluded; these fractions measure transaction coverage, not gas coverage. Excludes Lighter on Robinhood.

Execution gas divided by 21,000. This compares gas demand, not transaction usefulness.
